verdict.rationale: The skills in `skills/` are the single source of truth, shared verbatim across every harness. Porting never rewrites SKILL.md files (docs-13, docs-37), and the project lists support for many non-Claude agents including Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and Devin (gh-19, docs-31). A hands-on probe installed a skill folder through the vendor-neutral `npx skills add` installer, and its SKILL.md frontmatter (name field) read back cleanly (probe-rt-1). missing for 10: an explicit statement that the skills conform to the open Agent Skills specification, and independent validation of the frontmatter against that spec.
